avis.titre: Wildly Impressed – It Feels Weird But It Works
avis.texte: I was a little nervous to try the VT COSMETICS PDRN Reedle Shot 100 at first—“spicules” and “microneedling” in a bottle sounds intense. But now that I’ve been using it a few times a week for about a month, I can confidently say it’s one of the most unique and effective skincare products I’ve ever tried. The texture is light and watery, almost like a serum-toner hybrid, and when you pat it in… yep, you feel the “needles.” It’s not painful, but it’s definitely tingly—like a bunch of tiny prickles across your skin. It fades after a few minutes, and by the next morning, I always wake up with skin that looks smoother, more hydrated, and just more alive. I have combination skin with some texture and occasional breakouts, and this has really helped minimize the little bumps and dullness I deal with. My skin feels firmer, and my makeup sits better too, which I wasn’t expecting. I’ve also noticed the rest of my skincare absorbs like a dream after I use this—almost like it preps my face to get the most out of everything else. I will say, this probably isn’t for super sensitive skin, and you definitely want to follow it up with something soothing and hydrating. I started with twice a week and built up from there, and that’s been perfect for me. Bottom line: it feels a little weird the first time, but the glow and firmness it delivers is totally worth it. If you’re into skincare that actually does something and don’t mind a little tingle, this is a game-changer.

I’ve been using the VT COSMETICS PDRN Reedle Shot for a few weeks now, and I’m genuinely impressed with how effective it is. The texture feels unique—it’s not your typical serum. You can feel the micro-needling sensation slightly, but it’s not painful, just a bit tingly, which reassures me that it’s working deep into the skin. After consistent use, I’ve noticed: ✔️ Smoother skin texture ✔️ Reduced appearance of pores ✔️ Brighter, more even skin tone ✔️ Plumper, more hydrated skin I apply it at night, followed by a calming cream to help with any temporary redness. There’s a little bit of a “prickly” feeling during application, but it goes away quickly and is totally worth it for the results. Tip: Start with a lower number if you have sensitive skin, and work your way up. Would definitely repurchase. It feels like an at-home version of a professional skin treatment!

avis.texte: I really enjoy using the VT COSMETICS PDRN Reedle Shot 100 Serum in my skincare routine. The texture absorbs well and feels lightweight without leaving my skin greasy or heavy. I like how smooth and refreshed my skin feels after using it consistently, and it layers nicely with my other skincare products. It’s especially nice at night when I want my routine to feel a little more intensive. A great addition to my skincare routine.
